actions.action: Consume Phase 2 retained experience and preserve the existing receipt, validation, and runner spine rather than creating a parallel memory or context service.
Add stable immutable experience item identities and an evidence-backed relation contract for supersession, contradiction, and invalidation without rewriting historical receipts.
Add a deterministic Context Compiler with explicit relevance, freshness, supersession, contradiction, invalidation, item-budget, and character-budget controls.
Integrate compiled context into the existing deterministic runner while preserving reused_experience compatibility and execution_authorized=false.
Add positive and negative tests for deterministic compilation, future/stale/unrelated exclusion, supersession, unresolved contradiction, budget overflow, and authority neutrality.
Generalize the existing GEOS workflow into a Leverage Engine regression gate for all leverage-engine changes so later phases cannot silently bypass tests.
Run Leverage Engine regression, DiffWall, and repository-map validation on PR #47 under the operator's pre-authorized workahead boundary.

changes.change_summary: Added deterministic bounded authority-neutral Context Compiler.
Added canonical compiled context package contract.
Added evidence-backed relation metadata contract for immutable experience items.
Added compiled context to run output, evidence propagation, and ledger context identity.
Generalized the workflow trigger to validate every Leverage Engine change and all repository JSON syntax.

validation.scope: repository JSON syntax, execution receipt contract, Context Compiler tests, experience reuse tests, and full Leverage Engine regression suite
Phase 3 change-time risk including protected workflow generalization
Operator Intelligence registry and generated map integrity

operator_interventions.reason: Explicitly approved Phase 2 merge and workahead through every remaining planned phase until the final phase.
operator_interventions.effect: Bounded internal implementation and merges for Phases 2 through 5 are pre-authorized when each phase acceptance and validation pass; unexpected external-impact actions remain outside scope.

review_events.rationale: Operator explicitly pre-authorized workahead through the remaining planned phases; automated validation passed. DiffWall REVIEW is caused by the intentional protected CI generalization and is satisfied by this operator authorization.

friction: The Phase 1-named workflow was too narrowly path-scoped to guarantee regression validation for later Leverage Engine phases; it was generalized once rather than adding another workflow.
An accidental placeholder issue #46 was created during tool routing and closed immediately; issue #45 remains the canonical Phase 3 directive.

reusable_learnings.learning: Governed context compilation should be refusal-first: admission requires explicit relevance, freshness, relation consistency, and budget fit, with every exclusion carrying a deterministic reason.
Supersession and contradiction metadata should remain outside immutable historical receipts so later evidence can change what is admissible without rewriting what previously happened.
Regression infrastructure should trigger on the subsystem boundary rather than on phase-specific files; otherwise later compounding increments can silently escape the validation spine.

reused_experience.statement: Cross-run reuse can be added as a deterministic projection over validated receipts without creating a separate memory service, validator, or authority plane.
reused_experience.application: Phase 3 added a bounded compiler over the existing validated receipt store and runner rather than introducing a new database, policy engine, or independent memory service.
reused_experience.observed_effect: The Context Compiler reuses the existing receipt schema validator, paths, runner, and regression suite while adding only relation/context contracts and one compiler module.

reused_experience.statement: Historical experience reuse requires an explicit time cutoff and relevance boundary; otherwise replay can leak future knowledge or unrelated context into a run.
reused_experience.application: Phase 3 kept the future-state cutoff, added a deterministic max-age freshness window, explicit scope/project relevance, relation conflict handling, and hard context budgets.
reused_experience.observed_effect: Negative tests now prove future, stale, unrelated, superseded, contradicted, and over-budget context is excluded rather than silently admitted.

residual_risks: Context relevance is still deterministic exact scope/project matching rather than semantic retrieval.
Context relation records are manually curated in v0.1; automatic contradiction discovery is not implemented.
The compiler has not yet been stress-tested against large heterogeneous receipt histories.
No performance-aware agent/model/tool routing consumes the compiled context yet.
gate_reasons: all Phase 3 acceptance tests and full regression suite pass
operator explicitly pre-authorized workahead and merges through the final planned phase

next_improvement.objective: Build performance-aware executor routing that uses validated execution receipts to compare observed agent/model/tool outcomes, abstains when evidence is insufficient, and records the routing rationale for evaluation.
next_improvement.rationale: Context is now bounded and replayable; the next compounding step is to use retained outcome evidence to choose execution resources rather than routing manually or by assumption.
